name: concept-skills
description: Concept skills for a codebase: build and keep current a list of skills that explain the project's core concepts to agents (create-concept-skills, update-concept-skills, update-single-concept-skill), the scribe skill that decides where documentation goes, cleanup-skill to trim a skill to what a session needs, the load/explore helpers, and the code-architecture design checks. Works with or without Maestro. Set up with /concept-skills-install.
